description: Folded into fz-rs7.4. On develop the wrong-lane zero coercion this ticket was to remove does not exist: receive_value_int and receive_value_float return an error, as_raw_i64 and as_raw_f64 panic. The coercion was spike scaffolding. The dead-edge failure (184 of 296 mixed-lane guard programs failing to compile) appears only once guard operators resolve as Kernel calls, which is fz-rs7.4; without that change there is no failing test, and with it the live-edge-only emission is required for the commit to compile. Two steps that cannot land apart are one step. The live-edge work and its acceptance are in fz-rs7.4.
title: A test the lane decides emits only its live edge
